purpose: Introduce a contrast with a fuller connective.
keywords: Clause + けれども; noun / な-adjective + だけれども.
It is raining, but I will go out.
This book is long, but interesting.
I have a reservation; is Ms. Tanaka here?
formation: Clause + けれども; noun / な-adjective + だけれども.
restrictions: It can also soften an introduction or request.
mistake: The connective does not express a cause-and-effect relationship.
